first_pilot: One original front-opening blouse on the fitted mannequin, before transferring to Ao Dai and other avatars

interaction.cloth_hold: near Grip on either hand, two independent cloth patches
interaction.fastener_toggle: near Trigger edge on a specific closure; separate from distant menu buttons
interaction.range_status: starting UX proposal, needs Touch-controller calibration
guards: surface proximity, occlusion and facing check
one trigger press causes at most one transition
same closure has one operation owner
tracking loss cancels pending button action
closing requires edge alignment; cannot teleport cloth across torso

state_axes.note: Closure state and garment lifecycle are separate; open buttons do not automatically mean removed garment.

simulation_changes: Authored split edge banks and render faces; do not leave triangles or hidden bend/stretch links bridging an opening
Permanent stitches stay; only matching fastener constraints are disabled. Hardware remains attached to its fabric side.
Gradually release body supports by region after physical clearance, not merely after the last button opens
World-space garment simulation persists when unparented; preserve positions and velocity on hand/body handover
Release old skin/animation tethers and stop applying old bind transform once cloth is free
Single authoritative deformation solver; do not drive same vertices with both body skinning and an independent rigidbody
World gravity, body/cloth/self/interlayer/room contacts remain active throughout doffing
Independent active/sleep scheduler for garments away from the mannequin
Keep shared materials and meshes alive until garment instance is explicitly deleted
Restore body visibility before opening; do not hide the body to pass collision QA
constraints: Polo half-placket does not create a full front opening; over-head removal requires adequate neck/cuff clearance
A visually apparent button in a texture is insufficient to infer a functional closure
No inferred Newton forces or material breaking strength from Touch grip pressure
Do not enable arbitrary imported garment removal without topology, closure and collision metadata
planned_acceptance_scenarios: Open and reclose every fastener, keeping each hardware mesh attached to its correct panel
Hold one placket with one hand and toggle a button with the other; swap sides
Grab same garment with both hands, then release one; no jump or ownership loss
Reach through from back, through walls or from beyond activation distance; no action
Try removal while required fastener remains closed or cuff is too tight; block with local hint
Doff in stationary assisted pose, then remove left and right sleeves without crossing the body
Lose tracking while holding; no explosive impulse or accidental reclosure
Release last hand; garment falls, contacts floor/table, settles and can be picked up again
Move/pose mannequin after removal; free garment does not follow it
Change current outfit; previously removed garment remains with valid texture/material
Restore onto mannequin using explicit donning action, not release-near-body auto equip
Inspect front, back, armpits and opened regions for body visibility holes
Measure triangle-body, edge-edge and interlayer contacts during motion and compute frame-time percentiles on PCVR

penetration_gate.note: Sampled or swept QA cannot certify all possible interactions; do not claim mathematically zero penetration

performance_gate: Match measured P95/P99 frame times to actual HMD refresh budget; no FPS promise before runtime test
rollout: Author/validate one blouse and closure metadata
Full doff, drop, pick up, rewear
Adapt Ao Dai closure/raglan layers and repeat contact QA
Add per-avatar wardrobe to male/female pose mannequins
Increase animation speed only after contact and performance validation
